item.content:encoded:
The text weirdly went from very clear and understandable during the first half to leaving out important steps during recovery and exploration log. It would make sense during the dream bits, but there was an abrupt step here: "[This is Jason's situation in the care facility] — [We got him]" and the exploration log just starts out of nowhere.

I would have liked to hear what real world preparations they take, how oneiroi infection is prevented (since it is apparently proximity-based) and so on. If they are adhering to standard oneiroi containment protocols described in some previous article, maybe a reference to that would suffice. Dream sequences can obviously be weird, but the regular report could need some more clarification.

item.content:encoded:
Wow. This series continues to deliver a highly imaginative and powerful mix of surrealism and solid world-building.

I suspect this isn't supposed to have the goi-format tag, since it is a Foundation document.

ETA: I don't especially like the immersion breaking prose at the beginning, and I feel like there could have been more operational and procedural details. Notably there really doesn't seem to be a very clear model of how oineronauctics works, and this would probably could have had some more crunchier bits. The dossiers are a very nice touch and make tracking the characters a lot easier throughout the series.

I also feel like the timeline of the Xiapania storyline could have been laid out more plainly and it is hard to figure out where this report fits with the tales.
